findings.issue: the no-argument IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL relation was one-way and not tied to REAL_KINDS
findings.resolution: no-X .EQV. the conjunction over every REAL_KINDS kind, both directions

findings.issue: the true branch only round-tripped the mode without observing its effect
findings.resolution: radix-guarded TINY(x)/4 is subnormal under gradual underflow and zero under abrupt, with GET-confirmed changed and restored modes

findings.issue: IEEE_UNORDERED NaN rows did not pre-verify quiet versus signaling class
findings.resolution: rows pre-verify IEEE_CLASS; IEEE_INVALID for signaling NaNs is a permission ('may signal') and is not asserted

findings.issue: IEEE_OTHER_VALUE was not handled for IEEE_VALUE
findings.resolution: recorded as excluded by p3, an unnumbered restriction with no diagnostic
